HONEYLOG_API_URL.description: Honeylog ingestion endpoint for this site, for example `https://ingest.example.com/api/events`.

HONEYLOG_INGESTION_SECRET.description: Secret generated by Honeylog for signing Worker ingestion requests.

HONEYLOG_API_KEY.description: Optional Honeylog API key. Leave empty unless your Honeylog site requires bearer authentication.

HONEYLOG_SITE_DOMAIN.description: Canonical site domain in Honeylog, for example `example.com`.

HONEYLOG_SITE_SCHEME.description: Public URL scheme for tracked events. Use `https` unless the site intentionally runs on HTTP.

HONEYLOG_EVENT_NAME.description: Event name sent to Honeylog. Use `pageview` unless the site needs a custom event name.

HONEYLOG_SKIP_PATH_REGEX.description: Regex for static assets and paths that should not create pageview events.

ORIGIN_URL.description: Optional explicit upstream origin. Leave empty to proxy to Cloudflare's default origin.
